steps: 1. Enable Career Tweaker and the public Tweaker: Weapons stream, then restart.
2. In **Careers > Talent Reworks > Master Toggles**, confirm the Ensrick, Tourney Balance, and all-reworks controls are present and individual reworks carry their authored prefix.
3. Turn each career family master on in turn and confirm mutually exclusive families switch correctly.
4. Turn **Enable All Reworks** on, then turn one individual rework off; confirm the master returns to a custom/off state without changing the other choices.
5. In **Weapons > Weapon Tweaks > Master Toggles**, confirm the Ensrick master controls all 13 visible weapon tweaks and individual tweaks carry the Ensrick prefix.
6. Turn one individual weapon tweak off, then exercise the weapon master on and off; run `/crt_regression_test` and `/wt_regression_test`.
assertions: Every visible active rework belongs to one authored family, whole-family changes are bounded, partial selections remain intact, retired Big Rebalance rows remain absent, and both regression commands finish without an error or callback storm.
Script settings: toggle each family master, assert member settings follow, exclusive families switch, partial selection sets master to custom, bounded number of setting writes.
